name: r_zl_freeplay_city042_lit_base_mcw
description: One separate ordinary nighttime city account, installed from the native-saved zero-credit night footing.  The player may choose a routine stationary light and ordinary pauses or travel; only its native, player-visible consequences count.

steps.label: settle_ordinary_lit_base_copy
steps.expected_visible_fact: the native-saved nighttime copy loads before any ordinary player decision

steps.label: operate_ordinary_stationary_light
steps.objective: Make player-visible, ordinary nighttime decisions.  If useful, activate, turn off, or change the carried light through its currently advertised native item controls, remain stationary for a bounded interval, then choose ordinary movement or withdrawal from the actual World surface.  Do not manufacture an observer or attention event.
proof_targets: any visible, manageable hostile attention or its absence
ordinary movement, withdrawal, or survival consequence
invariants: the saved night footing earns zero credit
no debug or injected observer, attention, knowledge, contact, actor, or route
only player-visible native facts support the conclusion

steps.label: save_and_exit_ordinary_lit_base_account
steps.objective: At the honest ordinary-play boundary, use native Save and Quit, native Main-menu Quit, and their native confirmations.
steps.expected_visible_fact: the ordinary account saves, returns to the main menu, and its owned process exits

evidence_contract.claim: one separate ordinary account may supply a partial assessment of a player-selected stationary nighttime light and any naturally player-visible, manageable hostile attention or lighting change
evidence_contract.load_only_verdict: native-saved zero-credit footing only / no inherited ordinary credit
evidence_contract.writeback_note: the source fixture and carried-light state earn no ordinary evidence; only choices in this account do
